historyText: Explore the development stages of the modular Gizmo robot.
valueText: Automation should address the day-to-day needs of a growing operation without turning the way it works upside down.
valueChallengesLabel: Challenges Gizmo is designed to address

valueChallenges.title: Labour shortages
valueChallenges.text: A shortage of qualified workers can make it harder to keep your operations running smoothly.

valueChallenges.title: Repetitive physical work
valueChallenges.text: Harvesting, transport and other physical tasks take time that a team could spend on other responsibilities.

valueChallenges.title: Existing infrastructure
valueChallenges.text: Automation should work with the conditions and layout of the site where it will be used.

valueQuestion: Gizmo — modular robotics designed for repetitive tasks and existing infrastructure.

founders.name: Feliks Brzeziński
founders.bio: An automation and robotics engineer from Warsaw University of Technology, currently studying at the University of Oslo. He works on low-level software and electronics. Professionally, he has worked on control systems, measurement setups, and data-acquisition automation, collaborating with organizations including CERN

founders.name: Kacper Olszewski
founders.bio: An automation and robotics engineer from Warsaw University of Technology, currently continuing his studies at the master’s level in the same field. Professionally, he designs control and automation systems, gaining experience in areas such as the refining industry, building automation, and industrial machinery.

teamText: A multidisciplinary team turning practical challenges into dependable automation.

team.name: Weronika Arciuch
team.bio: An automation and robotics engineer with a master’s degree in computer engineering, specializing in data engineering, with both degrees completed at Warsaw University of Technology. She works with computer vision, machine learning, and AI applications in image analysis, including in collaboration with the IDEAS Research Institute. She combines her technical skills with experience in social media, taking care of our public image.

team.name: Zuzanna Miśkiewicz
team.bio: A finance and accounting student at the University of Warsaw, previously studying computer science at the Technical University of Munich. She focuses on business development, communication, and organizational management. She has previously worked with WARR e.V. and she.codes, where she was responsible for partnerships, event organization, and growth strategy.

team.name: Norbert Ciesielski
team.bio: An aerospace and satellite engineering graduate, currently studying electronics and telecommunications. He designs and commissions electronic systems, combining hardware with low-level software.

team.name: Antoni Banuch
team.bio: An automation and robotics engineer from Warsaw University of Technology, currently continuing his studies at the master’s level in the same field. He works with automation, robotics, and mechatronic systems. He has experience in assembling, commissioning, and programming industrial equipment.
